items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: You know Reuben Roddy, you know Roddy the saxophone?

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Bill Bessonet. And take money. Club. Tell me something else Tom. You know Reuben Roddy, you know Roddy the saxophone?

Yeah. Did you find any difference in the way he played? He come from Kansas City or something? Well yeah he played different style of saxophone. Different style or playing with the beat or what? Yeah different style. Yeah he played different style. You know yeah he played different style. But was the beat the same? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
